**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement's only exclusivity covenant, Section 5.8, runs against Harpoon and its Affiliates (no development, commercialization or licensing of Competing Products in the Territory), with Section 7.1.2 expressly confirming that exclusivity obligations exist only "in the case of Harpoon." Section 5.8.2 adds Harpoon-side acquisition/change-of-control carve-outs plus protective rights for AbbVie.

I checked Articles 3, 4 and 5 (grant of rights, development, commercialization), AbbVie's covenants in Section 10.4, and ran targeted searches for "AbbVie shall not", "compete", "Competing Product", "shall not Develop" and field/territory restrictions on our side — no non-compete, competing-product or field-of-use restriction binds AbbVie or its Affiliates, and no post-term restriction appears in the termination article. The Field/Territory language operates as license scope, not a restrictive covenant.

This sits at the playbook's preferred position (no non-compete on the customer), and the Harpoon-side restriction benefits us, so nothing to flag.
